title: S6 exact finite identity checks
scope: Integer matrix and local polynomial/monomial identities only.

results.statement: B0 is integral, unimodular, orthogonal, and invertible with B0^{-1}=-B0.
In C{x,y,z}/(xy), the common annihilator of x and y is zero.
In C{x,y,z}/(xyz), the common annihilator of yz, xz, and xy is zero.
The double-locus normalization/conductor inclusion-exclusion lift restricts to both branches.
results.certificate: For compatible h1=k(z)+y a(y,z), h2=k(z)+x b(x,z), h=h1+h2-k(z) has h|_{x=0}=h1 and h|_{y=0}=h2.

results.statement: The triple-locus normalization/conductor inclusion-exclusion lift restricts to all three branches.
results.certificate: A compatible polynomial family with common vertex value and pairwise-product remainders was reconstructed exactly on x=0, y=0, z=0.

results.statement: The coefficients of d(xy)=y dx+x dy vanish on the reduced double conductor.
The coefficients of d(xyz)=yz dx+xz dy+xy dz vanish on the reduced triple conductor.
The candidate's displayed twist integer is p=12*l0-4*l1-3*l2=-1.
